text: Claude independent review of imagery lane 5c96f9e (tree 38fa0b71) against 13_IMAGE_LAYER_ACCEPTANCE.md. Doc: claude/xenios-health-launch-review-20260930 @ e6fa1f5, 21_IMAGERY_REVIEW_5c96f9e.md (lens findings in imagery/5c96f9e_lens_findings.json). DISPOSITION: not mergeable into a release candidate as-is. P1 IMG-01 (re-verified): 10 permanently non-approvable AI candidates are under client/public/research/products/fallbacks; vite root=client with no publicDir override copies them to dist/public, and the only block is prose (fallback-assets.json enforcement 'not_a_runtime_access_control'); package.json runs no validator; every ledger/crosswalk row carries an href to them. Fix: move them out of client/public (e.g. docs/product-imagery/review-candidates/), emit an explicit no-deployable-candidate state instead of hrefs, and add a build check that fails if dist/public holds any deploymentEligibility=blocked asset. P2: IMG-ID-01 (re-verified) the Hexarelin 5 mg/Oxytocin 10 mg override is keyed GEN-GRP-0402/0407 (lib.mjs:385), the superseded rows; C11 says map by the kept GRP-0426/0425 only; add a forward crosswalk and do not queue exact renders for mov_7c55/mov_256cb. IMG-ID-02 coverage pins 420/419; the founder reversal makes 424 canonical (GRP-0421/0423/0424 included, 0422 held, 0425/0426 new ids); add a pending-identity section and derive counts from data. IMG-ID-03/TRUTH-05 (re-verified) journeyClassFor replicates runtime authority, checks unbound before holds, never reads commerceHolds or formulation holds; the resolver must take authorityFor/earlyAccessCustomerPathway as input. IMG-ID-04 (re-verified) recorded source hashes are CRLF working-tree hashes (dataset recorded 108e81b2 vs blob b8634a5d); hash git blobs or normalize LF. IMG-ID-05 name one exact-media authority (EA imageState vs the mov_ manifest). TRUTH-03 exact-render prompts inject marks, fill volume, concentration and counts, omit the style-guide rejection list, and allow 'unless exact packaging evidence'; add a prompt validator and correct V3_ACCEPTANCE_TRACE:41. TRUTH-04 Care (242) and held (33) rows are queued for product renders, and an exact asset beats the journey fallback; exclude them or let journey win. TRUTH-06 flag retail supplement units by data, not an 8-name list, and make restrictions a set (LIBIDO CREAM loses its claim restriction). TRUTH-07 C7 Superpower/Mito is not handed off (DiagnosticsExperience.tsx:69 still says Diagnostics partner). INFRA-02/03/04 no gate runs the validators, provisional and approved share one namespace, and the reference scan skips client/public, index.html, config and content. PASS: binary hygiene (VP8, no EXIF/XMP, hash-suffixed names, 292 KB), no text/logos/people in the images, 420/419/417/22-alias counts, all 19 forms mapped, 29 form-not-stated rows neutral, the A6 commerce isolation prerequisite is planned, no protected file touched. Payment remains the core priority; this does not block it.
